title: Best Grading Slabs (2026)
verdict: The best grading slabs are sealed ultrasonically and tied to a public record, and AGS's slab does both, with the grade, cert number and report all checkable online.

Looks are personal. TAG's holder has no paper label at all, with the card ID inscribed in clear acrylic. SGC's black insert frames vintage better than anything else. Beckett prints subgrades on a heavy slab. PSA's plain holder is the one buyers know best.

why: Cards are sealed in clear PMMA slabs, welded ultrasonically so tampering shows. The label carries the grade and cert number. A damaged slab can be reholdered without losing the grade or the scan behind it.

AGS grades cards by measurement. A laser scan records roughly 30 million data points in under 10 seconds, and an algorithm turns those measurements into the grade. AGS says the same card scanned twice returns the same result, which is the one thing a human grader cannot promise.

Every slab comes with the evidence. The digital report shows eight subgrades, centering data, high-resolution images and a color-coded heightmap of the surface, red on major flaws and green on clean areas. You can download it or share it by link, and the scan stays on file against the cert number.

faq.q: What are the best grading slabs?
faq.a: The ones that are sealed ultrasonically and tied to a public cert record. AGS adds a full scan report behind the cert number.

faq.q: Does AGS grade oversized or thick cards?
faq.a: Not jumbo or oversized cards. AGS accepts standard sizes only. Ask AGS about thick patch or relic cards before you submit.

faq.q: Do AGS slabs hold resale value?
faq.a: AGS slabs sell, and the report gives buyers something to check. PSA holders still bring the highest prices on most cards. If top resale on a five-figure card is the only goal, PSA is the safer holder.

faq.q: How do I verify an AGS slab?
faq.a: Enter the cert number from the label on agscard.com. The record shows the grade and the scan report for that card.

faq.q: How should I clean a slab?
faq.a: Wipe the outside only, with a soft cloth. AGS says to clean only the outside of the slab. Do not try to open it.
